scope: Read-only audits of original local-window models, not an integrated model or mapper benchmark

durable_copy.content_digest_method: SHA256 of newline-separated per-file SHA256 hex digests, nodes order, images then cameras then points; paths excluded

source_digest.method: SHA256 of concatenated sha256sum output records (including paths), in nodes TSV order, each node images.txt then sibling cameras.txt then points3D.txt

coordinate_identity.method: Per-image SHA256 of ordered little-endian float64 x,y pairs; POINT3D_ID excluded

source_geometry.method: Reproject actual points through each source PINHOLE camera and world-to-camera pose; verify both image-to-point and point-to-image references

naive_union_diagnostic.decision: Do not use unguarded transitive union; detect conflicts before mutating ownership

unique_observation_support_before_filter.note: Deduplicated by image name and original keypoint index; before collision rejection or atlas-pose triangulation. A zero-observation sensor image may still belong to a supported calibrated rig frame.

colmap_projection_crosscheck.note: Frozen historical gate is unchanged. Report the direct projection comparison as well; stored per-point ERROR values are not universally exact.

limitations: Observation counts include duplicates between overlapping windows
Reprojection describes source poses, not final atlas poses
Coordinate identity alone does not validate a merged track's geometry
No integrated registration, trajectory, reprojection, or performance gate is claimed
